extension_name.description: The display name for the extension.

extension_description.message: Fills logins, passwords, and TOTP codes from KeePassXC into Safari.
extension_description.description: Description of what the extension does, shown in Safari's extension settings.

entries_heading.description: Heading above the list of matching entries.

button_associate.description: Button that starts the association with KeePassXC.

button_generate.description: Button that generates a new password.

button_totp.description: Button that copies the TOTP code.

error_host_app_not_running.message: The SafariKeePassXC app is not running. Please start it and keep it open.
error_host_app_not_running.description: Shown when the host app is not running.

error_keepassxc_not_reachable.message: KeePassXC is not reachable. Is KeePassXC running with browser integration enabled?
error_keepassxc_not_reachable.description: Shown when KeePassXC cannot be reached.

error_database_locked.message: The KeePassXC database is locked. Please unlock it.
error_database_locked.description: Shown when the database is locked.

error_not_associated.description: Shown when the extension is not associated with KeePassXC.

error_unknown.description: Placeholder when no error details are available.

save_failed.message: The login could not be saved.
save_failed.description: Shown when saving a login from the save banner failed.

entries_empty.description: Shown when no entries match the current page.

entry_fill_tooltip.description: Tooltip on an entry button that fills the login form.

fill_no_form.message: No login form found on this page.
fill_no_form.description: Shown when filling failed because no form was found.

fill_no_access.message: The extension has no access to this page. Allow access to this website in Safari settings and reload the page.
fill_no_access.description: Shown when the content script is not injected.

status_associating.message: Connecting… (please confirm the dialog in KeePassXC)
status_associating.description: Shown while association is in progress.

status_not_associated.description: Shown when connected but not associated.

copied_to_clipboard.description: Appended after a value that was copied to the clipboard.

password_copied.message: Password generated and copied to the clipboard.
password_copied.description: Shown after a generated password was copied; the password itself is never displayed.

clipboard_failed.message: Clipboard unavailable. The password was not displayed.
clipboard_failed.description: Shown when copying a generated password to the clipboard failed.

totp_no_website.message: No website in the active tab.
totp_no_website.description: Shown when the active tab is not a website.

totp_no_entry.message: No TOTP entry for this page.
totp_no_entry.description: Shown when no entry with TOTP matches the current page.

save_banner_new.message: Save the login “$LOGIN$” for this site in KeePassXC?
save_banner_new.description: Banner question when new credentials were submitted.

save_banner_update.message: Update the saved password for “$LOGIN$” in KeePassXC?
save_banner_update.description: Banner question when a known login used a new password.

save_banner_button_save.description: Banner button that stores the new entry.

save_banner_button_update.description: Banner button that updates the existing entry.

save_banner_dismiss.description: Banner button that discards the queued credentials.

save_group_label.description: Label of the dropdown choosing the target group for new entries.

save_group_default.description: Dropdown option for KeePassXC's default browser group.

passkeys_toggle_label.description: Checkbox that routes WebAuthn passkey requests to KeePassXC.

passkeys_toggle_hint.message: Takes effect after the page reloads. When off, Safari handles passkeys.
passkeys_toggle_hint.description: Explains when the passkey setting takes effect.

passkeys_reload_hint.message: Reload the page for the change to take effect.
passkeys_reload_hint.description: Shown right after the passkey setting changed.

passkeys_bridge_stopped.message: Passkeys are unavailable: the SafariKeePassXC app is not running.
passkeys_bridge_stopped.description: Passkey diagnostics when the host app is stopped.

passkeys_not_associated.message: Connect to KeePassXC to use passkeys.
passkeys_not_associated.description: Passkey diagnostics when there is no KeePassXC association.

passkeys_unsupported_version.description: Passkey diagnostics for an incompatible KeePassXC version.

passkeys_page_not_active.message: The passkeys bridge is not active on this page. Reload the page and make sure the extension has access to this website.
passkeys_page_not_active.description: Shown when the page-world passkey adapter did not install.

passkeys_fallback_reason.message: The last passkey request was handled by Safari instead of KeePassXC ($REASON$).
passkeys_fallback_reason.description: Shown when the page adapter deliberately fell back to Safari.

nav_search.description: Toolbar button that opens the vault search screen.

nav_generator.description: Toolbar button that opens the password generator.

nav_settings.description: Toolbar button that opens the settings screen.

nav_back.description: Back button in the popup sub-header.

screen_generator_title.description: Title of the password generator screen.

status_connected_short.description: Header status when connected to KeePassXC.

status_locked.description: Header status when the database is locked.

status_offline.description: Header status when KeePassXC is not reachable.

status_unpaired.description: Header status when the extension is not associated.

section_for_site.description: Section label above the logins matching the current page.

home_empty_title.description: Empty state title when no entry matches the page.

home_empty_hint.message: Find an entry in the vault or search your logins.

button_search.description: Empty state button that opens the search screen.

button_create.description: Empty state button that would create a new login.

toast_filled.description: Toast after filling a login form.

toast_totp_copied.description: Toast after copying a TOTP code.

toast_password_copied.description: Toast after copying a generated password.

toast_password_pasted.description: Toast after pasting a generated password.

error_offline_hint.message: Open KeePassXC and enable browser integration.
error_offline_hint.description: Error screen hint when KeePassXC is not running.

error_locked_hint.message: Unlock the vault to see your logins.
error_locked_hint.description: Error screen hint when the database is locked.

error_pairing_required.description: Error screen title when the extension is not associated.

error_unpaired_hint.message: Confirm the extension connection in the KeePassXC window.
error_unpaired_hint.description: Error screen hint when the extension is not associated.

button_retry.description: Error screen button that retries the connection.

button_unlock_in_keepassxc.description: Error screen button shown when the database is locked.

button_pair.description: Error screen button that starts the association.

settings_save_prompt.description: Settings toggle that shows the save banner.

settings_autofill_hint.message: When a single login is found for the site.

settings_not_connected.description: Settings connection row when not connected.

settings_reconnect.description: Settings button that reconnects to KeePassXC.

generator_phrase_hint.message: Hyphen-separated words are easier to remember.

generator_keepassxc.description: Button that generates a password with KeePassXC settings.

generator_copy.description: Tooltip on the copy password button.

search_clear.description: Tooltip on the clear search button.

search_hint.description: Explains that the search is scoped to the current site.

search_in_keepassxc.description: Opens KeePassXC's global search for the whole database.

search_all.description: Search label when the query is empty.
